# Local overrides (0.5.114)

Two entries in this manifest are FORK-LOCAL and will be DROPPED if the
manifest is regenerated by scripts/build-claude-science-manifest.mjs (which
walks the upstream OpenScience tree):

- agents/critique.txt (+ manifest agents entry; counts.agents 6)
- skills/research/reproduce/SKILL.md (+ entry; counts.skills 295)

NOTE: skills/research/peer-review/ is NOT local — the upstream tree already
ships a 715-line peer-review skill under that exact path; an earlier draft of
this batch accidentally overwrote it and was reverted (keep that lesson:
git ls-files before overwriting vendor payloads). Only reproduce + critique
need re-adding after a regen. The server install handler and the critique
auto-enqueue hook expect the critique agent to exist.
